set_layer_config: set layer-specific quantization configs for a PyTorch model with regex expansion and GGUF support
get_layer_config_by_gguf_format: get layer config mapped to a target GGUF quantization format for a given model
block_forward: perform a forward pass through a model block with optional mixed precision and device placement
IndexSampler_next_batch: create an IndexSampler and get the next batch of shuffled sample indices for calibration data
infer_bits_by_data_type: infer the bit width from a quantization data type string like int4 or fp8
